text:
Alex: Heads-up  Demo day is Thurs at the Kendall Square office. Thinking a quick picnic in the plaza after  want easy food options. 12:30pm-ish. Ideas?
Priya: Ooh picnic sounds great. Two local options: Mike's Deli does huge pastrami platters that feed a group. Also Grain & Green does build-your-own vegan bowls and salads.
Marcus: Pastrami + pickles forever :sandwich: but Grain & Green is nice for the veg crew.
Jen: We have one nut allergy in the group and one pescatarian. Mike's can separate sides, and G&G notes nuts on some bowls.
Sofia: Can we do half-and-half? Pastrami platter + a few trays of vegan bowls. Keeps everyone happy and easy to serve.
Kevin: Logistics: do we want to order for pickup and bring blankets, or use office plates + trash bags? Also need napkins + cutlery.
Alex: I can pickup if someone places the order. Blanket volunteers? I'll bring a couple.
Priya: I can place the order. Poll: react with :one: All pastrami  :two: All vegan  :three: Split platter (recommended)
Marcus: :three:
Jen: :three: (and please mark nut-free bowls)
Sofia: :three:
Kevin: :three:
Priya: Okay placing order w/ Mike's Deli for two pastrami platters + sides and Grain & Green for 6 vegan bowls (nut-free flagged) as backup. Pickup at 12:15, bring to plaza. Estimated total ~$95.
Alex: Legend. Can you send pickup ETA?
Priya: Pickup confirmed: Thu 12:10pm from Mike's Deli, order #MD-4432. G&G confirmation #GG-889, 6 nut-free bowls ready 12:05pm.
Jen: Adding to calendar so demo folks see it.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar  "Thu demo picnic: Mike's Deli + Grain & Green (12:30pm)".
Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll bring two blankets and some utensils. See you Thursday! :sun_with_face:
